# Permissions

<!-- Generated by `pnpm docs:permissions` from packages/auth/src/permissions.ts. Do not edit by hand. -->

Code checks permission keys, never role names (D-07). **Scope** `tenant` means only a role assigned to
all branches grants it; `branch` means a role assigned to one branch grants it for that branch only.

### Second factor (D-03)

| Role | Email OTP |
| --- | --- |
| Gym Owner | Always (no trusted-device skip) |
| Gym Administrator | Always (no trusted-device skip) |
| Branch Manager | When the gym requires it (trusted device allowed for 30 days) |
| Receptionist | When the gym requires it (trusted device allowed for 30 days) |
| Sales Staff | When the gym requires it (trusted device allowed for 30 days) |
| Trainer | When the gym requires it (trusted device allowed for 30 days) |
| Accountant | When the gym requires it (trusted device allowed for 30 days) |
| Member | Optional, off by default |

## Platform realm (apps/admin)

Every platform user signs in with email + password and a mandatory email OTP.

| Permission | What it allows | Super Admin | Platform Support |
| --- | --- | :---: | :---: |
| `platform.tenants.view` | See tenants, subscriptions and usage | ✓ | ✓ |
| `platform.tenants.manage` | Create, approve, suspend and reactivate tenants | ✓ |  |
| `platform.plans.manage` | Edit plans, feature values and tenant overrides | ✓ |  |
| `platform.settings.manage` | Change platform settings | ✓ |  |
| `platform.audit.view` | Read the platform audit log | ✓ |  |
| `platform.support.access` | Open time-boxed, read-only support sessions | ✓ | ✓ |
| `platform.billing.view` | See SaaS subscriptions, invoices, payments, MRR and usage | ✓ | ✓ |
| `platform.billing.manage` | Platform payment account, plan prices, trial extensions and comps | ✓ |  |
| `platform.announcements.manage` | Publish announcements to gyms | ✓ |  |
| `platform.system.view` | See system health, queues and failed jobs (and retry them) | ✓ | ✓ |
